paragraphs.source_en: Badger is clever; Red-shirt is no less so. They both declared that the boys were not to blame when they were naughty, but the teacher. A man of mental derangement strikes you on the head. You are bad and the lunatic strikes you. Thus their logic goes on. Happy stars! If the boys are full of energy, let them go out into the playground and have wrestling. Unbearable it would be if grasshoppers were thrown into one's bed half-unconsciously. If this goes on and on, one's head will be cut off and carried away while one is asleep, and they will set the head-hunters free, saying it has partly been done out of unconsciousness.
